title: Inter's Pio Esposito: 10 Goals for Italy at 21. Start Him Over Lautaro? #Shorts
description:
Pio Esposito has 10 goals for Italy at 21. We say he starts for Inter in Bergamo, Lautaro or not.
Free daily digest in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=76

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED — Esposito scored in the 11th minute of Italy's 4–1 loss to Belgium, his 10th goal in 15 games for Italy; only Giuseppe Meazza reached ten younger. Source: Inter.it, Nov 15.
REPORTED — Lautaro Martínez rejoins group training this week, and QS expects about half an hour from him at Atalanta on Sunday. Source: Gazzetta dello Sport and QS via FCInterNews, Nov 16.
NEXT UP — Atalanta vs Inter, Sunday, Nov 22, 2:45 PM ET (20:45 CET), Serie A Matchday 12. US TV: Paramount+.
